The report now shows `REORDER` for any item whose stock on hand is less than 6 days of average sales. `LEAD_TIME_DAYS = 6` sits at the top of `stock_report.py` for when you switch suppliers.

Running it on your current `inventory.csv` flags two items:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend has about 3.75 days left (9 on hand at 2.4 a day) and oat milk has 4 (30 at 7.5 a day), so both would run out before a delivery ordered today arrives.

- **No safety margin:** an item with exactly 6 days of stock still shows `ok`, since on average it runs out just as the boxes arrive. In practice that means the flag often appears when you're already a day or so too late to avoid a gap. If you want it to appear earlier, bump the number up top to 7 or 8.
- **Stock already on order isn't counted:** the CSV has no "on order" column, so an item keeps showing `REORDER` every night until the delivery is on the shelf.
